test_title: PYST 49: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the given letter series.

L M B A _ H O L M B A C _ O L M _ A C H O L _ B A C H O L _
solution:
Given series: L M B A _ H O L M B A C _ O L M _ A C H O L _ B A C H O L _

Option 1) CHMBM→ L M B A __C__ H O L M B A C __H__ O L M __M__ A C H O L __B__ B A C H O L __M__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) CMHBM → L M B A __C__ H O L M B A C __M__ O L M __H__ A C H O L __B__ B A C H O L __M__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) CHBMM → L M B A __**C**__ H O L M B A C __**H**__ O L M __**B**__ A C H O L __**M**__ B A C H O L __**M**__ → (It follows the pattern of: LMBACHO - LMBACHO - LMBACHO - LMBACHO - LM)

Option 4) CHMMB → L M B A __C__ H O L M B A C __H__ O L M __M__ A C H O L __M__ B A C H O L __B__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
